name: Domiciliary Care
title_html: Personalised support in the comfort of home
tagline: Home care visits — daily, weekly or whenever you need us.
meta: Domiciliary home care in Redbridge and London: personal care, medication, meals, mobility and companionship from Task Healthcare's CQC-rated Good team.
intro: Support with everyday living in the comfort and familiarity of your own home — tailored to you, and adjusted as your needs change.
lede: Domiciliary care — also known as home care or in-home care — is a range of support provided to people in the comfort and familiarity of their own homes. It’s particularly valuable for those who need help with daily activities but prefer to stay in their own living environment, and it covers a wide spectrum of support tailored to each person’s unique needs.
features: Personal care
Help with everyday activities such as bathing, dressing, toileting and grooming.
Medication management
Reminders so prescribed medications are taken at the correct times and in the right doses.
Mobility support
Help moving around the home, transferring to and from chairs or beds, and staying safe on the move.
Meal preparation & nutrition
Meal planning, grocery shopping and cooking, so you receive balanced and nutritious meals.
Companionship
Conversation and activities that support mental and emotional well-being.
Household tasks
Light housekeeping such as laundry, cleaning and organising living spaces.
Transportation
Help getting to medical appointments, grocery shopping and other essential errands.
Specialised care
Care tailored to specific medical or care needs.
Respite care
Temporary relief for family carers, while their loved one receives consistent care.
Safety & security
Carers trained to spot potential hazards in the home and take steps to minimise risks.
Emotional support
A listening ear for anyone experiencing isolation or loneliness.
Flexibility
Care plans that evolve as your requirements change.
outro: Our domiciliary care aims to promote independence, enhance quality of life and create a safe, supportive environment. Each care plan is carefully crafted around the specific needs and preferences of the client, so they receive the highest standard of care.
hero_alt: A Task Healthcare carer greeting an older man at his front door
side_alt: A carer serving tea and biscuits to a client at home
card: Visits at home, daily or weekly.

quote.text: Very caring, fantastic support, always arrives on time, no clock watching. My mother is treated with dignity and patience… she goes far and beyond.

name: Live-In Care
tagline: A dedicated, highly trained carer who lives with you.
meta: Live-in care across Redbridge and London: a dedicated carer at home 24/7 — an alternative to a nursing or residential home. CQC rated Good.
intro: For people who need continuous support, a compassionate live-in carer brings round-the-clock care and companionship — an alternative to moving into a nursing or residential home.
lede: For people who need continuous support and assistance, our live-in care provides a compassionate, highly trained carer who lives with the client, ensuring round-the-clock care and companionship. It’s particularly helpful for those with complex needs, or anyone who wants the reassurance of always having someone there. You keep your daily routines, your possessions and your pets — and friends and family can keep visiting as they always have.
features: Comprehensive support
Experienced carers help with personal care, medication management, mobility support and more.
Personalised care plans
Every plan is built around the person’s unique needs, preferences and goals.
24/7 availability
Your carer is in the home around the clock, ready to help in an emergency or with any other need.
Companionship
Conversation and shared activities that promote mental and emotional well-being.
Privacy & dignity
Carers trained to give care with the utmost sensitivity and respect.
Maintaining independence
Support that preserves a sense of self-reliance and autonomy.
Household management
Help with laundry, cleaning, ironing and organising living spaces.
Nutrition & meal preparation
Balanced, nutritious homemade meals that respect dietary needs and preferences.
Safety measures
Carers who identify and address potential hazards to create a secure home.
Flexibility in care
Plans that are adjusted as needs change over time.
Communication & updates
Families are kept informed about well-being and any changes to the care plan.
Continuity of care
If your carer takes holiday, falls ill — or you simply don’t get on — we provide a replacement.
outro: Live-in care gives individuals and families the peace of mind of knowing reliable, compassionate care is always available. Our carers are dedicated to the comfort, safety and well-being of those they support, so people can keep living in the familiarity of their own homes.
hero_alt: A smiling carer holding hands with an older man in a wheelchair at home
side_alt: A carer chatting with an older couple on their sofa
card: A dedicated carer, round the clock.

quote.text: All my needs are taken care of, and I am never left without a carer. My carers come to feel like members of my family.

name: Dementia Care
tagline: Care that protects routine, dignity and quality of life.
meta: Specialist dementia care at home in Redbridge and London. Trained carers, person-centred plans, routine and family support from Task Healthcare.
intro: Caring for someone with dementia takes empathy, patience and specialised training. We create a calm, supportive environment that gives the highest possible quality of life.
lede: Caring for people with dementia requires a unique approach built on empathy, patience and specialised training. At Task Healthcare we recognise the challenges faced both by people living with dementia and by their families. Our dementia care is designed to create a supportive, comforting environment that delivers the highest possible quality of life.
features_title: How we support people living with dementia
features: Specialised training
Our carers are trained in dementia care to give compassionate, effective support.
Person-centred care
Every person is unique — plans are tailored to their needs, preferences and abilities.
Routine & familiarity
Consistent schedules and familiar surroundings create a sense of security.
Engaging activities
Stimulating activities matched to interests that support cognition and reduce agitation.
Safe environment
Safety measures that help prevent accidents and wandering.
Communication strategies
Techniques that reduce frustration and improve understanding.
Nutrition & hydration
Help with meal planning and preparation, and monitoring hydration.
Dignity & independence
People make their own choices and take part to the best of their abilities.
Family involvement
Regular updates, involvement in care planning, and emotional support for families.
24/7 availability
Support around the clock, for peace of mind for everyone.
Palliative & end-of-life care
For advanced dementia, care focused on comfort and quality of life.
outro: Our dementia care is designed to enhance well-being and quality of life — an environment of trust, understanding and comfort that lets people age with dignity and grace.
hero_alt: A carer laughing with an older man in a wheelchair by a window
side_alt: A carer hugging a smiling older woman

quote.text: Most important of all, I am treated with dignity and not as an old person with dementia.

name: Respite Care
tagline: Take a break, knowing your loved one is in capable hands.
meta: Respite care in Redbridge and London: a few hours, overnight or longer, so family carers can rest. Professional, consistent care from Task Healthcare.
intro: Caring for a loved one is deeply rewarding, but carers need time to recharge too. Our respite care gives you a break, with your loved one in capable hands.
lede: Caring for a loved one can be deeply rewarding, but it’s also essential for carers to take breaks to recharge and look after themselves. Our respite care offers temporary relief, so family members or primary carers can rest knowing their loved one is in capable hands.
features: Temporary relief for carers
A well-deserved break that reduces burnout, so you return feeling refreshed.
Professional carers
Highly trained carers step in seamlessly, with the same compassion and expertise.
Continuity of care
We learn the person’s routines, preferences and needs for a smooth transition.
Flexible scheduling
A few hours, a full day, overnight, or an extended period.
Companionship & engagement
Activities that support mental, emotional and physical well-being.
Help with daily living
Support with bathing, dressing, grooming and mobility.
Medication management
Prescribed medications taken correctly and at the right times.
Respite at home
Care in familiar surroundings, for a sense of security and comfort.
Family education & support
Resources and information to help families with the challenges of caring.
Stress reduction for carers
Regular breaks to protect your own physical and emotional well-being.
Emergency preparedness
Carers trained to handle emergencies and keep your loved one safe.
outro: We recognise the dedication and commitment of family carers. Our respite care gives you the support and relief you need to keep providing high-quality care to the people you love — while looking after your own well-being too.
hero_alt: A carer adjusting an older man's shirt as he sits in a wheelchair
side_alt: A carer bringing a meal to an older couple

quote.text: I am happy with all the team, all of the girls are lovely. The service has been excellent. I would highly recommend Task Health Care to everyone.

name: End-of-Life Care
title_html: Comfort, dignity and compassion in every moment
tagline: Palliative care for the person — and support for the family.
meta: Palliative and end-of-life care at home across London. Comfort, dignity, pain management and family support from Task Healthcare's compassionate team.
intro: During serious illness or at the end of life, comfort, dignity and emotional support matter most. We provide specialised, compassionate care for a peaceful transition.
lede: During serious illness or at the end of life, comfort, dignity and emotional support become paramount. At Task Healthcare we understand the needs and challenges individuals and families face at these difficult times. Our palliative and end-of-life care is designed to provide specialised, compassionate support that enhances quality of life and ensures a peaceful transition.
features_title: How we care at the end of life
features: A holistic approach
We care for physical needs and for emotional, social and spiritual well-being.
Pain management
Working closely with healthcare professionals so pain and discomfort are managed effectively.
Emotional & psychological support
Compassionate listening and companionship to ease anxiety and distress.
Respect for wishes & dignity
Decisions about treatment, comfort and end-of-life choices are respected.
Help with daily activities
Gentle help with daily living, given with sensitivity and respect.
Family involvement
Care plans created together with family, in line with the person’s wishes.
Crisis management
Experienced carers who support both the individual and their family through crises.
Spiritual & cultural sensitivity
Diverse beliefs and traditions are honoured and built into care.
Legacy & memory care
Space to share stories, memories and wishes for their legacy.
Grief support
Support and resources to help families through the grieving process.
24/7 availability
Reassurance and support whenever it’s needed, day or night.
outro: Our palliative and end-of-life care brings comfort, dignity and compassionate support at a sensitive time — so individuals and families can focus on cherishing the moments they have together.
hero_alt: A carer's hands gently holding an older person's hands
side_alt: A carer sitting with a client resting in bed

quote.text: As my mother-in-law faced her final moments, Task Healthcare’s carers exhibited unparalleled compassion. They tended to her emotional well-being, ensuring she felt comforted and loved.

name: Supported Living
tagline: Autonomy, choice and inclusion — in a community setting.
meta: Supported living services in London: individual support plans, 24/7 help, community engagement and independence for adults with a range of needs.
intro: Supported living helps people with a range of abilities and needs live as independently as possible within the community — with freedom and control over their own lives.
lede: Supported living is designed to help people with a range of abilities and needs live as independently as possible within a community setting. It provides support tailored to each person’s specific requirements, fostering autonomy, choice and inclusion. Our supported living programme creates a nurturing environment where people receive the help they need while enjoying freedom and control over their own lives.
features: Individualised support plans
Developed with the person, their family and relevant professionals.
Safe, comfortable homes
Accessible living spaces that meet each resident’s needs.
24/7 support
Trained staff available around the clock, whenever help is needed.
Daily living assistance
Help with meals, medication, personal hygiene and mobility.
Community engagement
Joining local activities and events for friendship and belonging.
Encouraging independence
Building and keeping the skills needed for independent living.
Advocacy & empowerment
Making sure every resident’s voice is heard and preferences respected.
Health & well-being
Health monitoring, help with appointments and healthy-living guidance.
Transition support
A stable environment through moves and changes in care needs.
Specialised services
Therapy, behavioural support or medical care built in where needed.
Regular reviews
Plans reviewed and adjusted as needs and goals evolve.
Choice & dignity
Residents decide their own routines, activities and lifestyle.
outro: Supported living puts the autonomy and dignity of each person first — helping people make their own choices about daily routines, activities and lifestyle, with dependable support behind them.

side_alt: A carer walking with a client in a park at sunset

quote.text: I can’t express enough gratitude for the incredible care my grandma received. Task Health Care are not just professional but incredibly compassionate.
